title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-kkj5: TH_4 test vector not updated for corrected credential
description:
## Commit: 9cc9cc013c

The commit fixes the TH_4 computation in edhoc.rs for both initiator and responder to use CRED_R (responder's credential) instead of CRED_I (initiator's credential), which is correct per RFC 9528 Section 4.1.

However, the test at line 1639 in test_rfc_9529_example_2 changed from:
```rust
transcript_4(&th_3, &plaintext_3, &credential_i).unwrap()
```
to:
```rust
transcript_4(&th_3, &plaintext_3, &credential_r).unwrap()
```

But the expected value `th_4 = hex!("ad002457080da9a5e7a942030ca302f5cc9f77ba8124a49ba560d168b5b6f26d")` was NOT updated. Since credential_r and credential_i are different certificates (different serial numbers, different CNs, different public keys), the transcript_4 hash output will differ. The expected value was computed with credential_i and must be recomputed with credential_r for the test to pass.

## Impact
- The test assertion will fail because the hash changes with the corrected credential input
- The TH_4 fix itself is spec-correct, but the test vector validation is broken
- Cannot verify correctness until the expected value is recomputed

## Fix needed
- Recompute TH_4 with credential_r and update the expected value in the test
- Verify against RFC 9529 Appendix B.3 test vectors
